messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
Which types of machinery are always subject to a conformity assessment procedure that involves a notified body?

response.text: Quali tipi di macchinari sono sempre soggetti a una procedura di valutazione della conformità che coinvolge un organismo notificato?
